{{Quote|It's too bad only commandos get Bacta processing implants, I could use all the help I can get.|Boss, upon seeing some deceased and severely injured clone troopers|<ref name="RC" />}}
A '''bacta processing implant''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant given to [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Because of the enhancement, the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]],<ref name="RC" /> part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]<ref name="HC" /> of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], were able to quickly process the medical substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], allowing them to heal critical injuries in seconds. Incapacitated commandos could be quickly revived in seconds by their squadmates, courtesy of a hand-held jumpstarter unit. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] were not equipped with such implants, to the disappointment of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commando [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] when he was separated from his [[Delta Squad/Legends|squad]] during their [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster]].<ref name="RC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bacta processing implants were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', released in [[2005]]. The implants were not shown, and were only mentioned once by Boss when he came across some injured and [[Death/Legends|deceased]] troopers.
